ko.title: 착한 나무꾼
ko.body: 옛날 깊은 산에 마음씨 착한 나무꾼이 살았어요. 나무를 하다 떨어진 개암을 하나둘 주웠지요.

en.title: The Kind Woodcutter
en.body: Long ago, a kind-hearted woodcutter lived deep in the mountains. As he chopped wood, he picked up the fallen hazelnuts one by one.
en.line: “This one's for my parents, and this one for my child.”

ko.title: 저물어 든 빈집
ko.body: 날이 저물자 나무꾼은 산속 빈집으로 들어가 쉬었어요. 곧 밖에서 무언가 두런두런 소리가 들렸지요.

en.title: An Empty House at Dusk
en.body: When night fell, the woodcutter went into an empty mountain house to rest. Soon he heard murmuring voices outside.

ko.title: 도깨비들의 잔치
ko.body: 빈집에 도깨비들이 몰려와 방망이를 두드렸어요. "금 나와라 뚝딱!" 하자 정말 금이 쏟아졌지요.

en.title: The Goblins' Feast
en.body: A band of goblins crowded into the house and pounded their magic clubs. “Gold, come out!” they shouted, and gold truly poured out.
en.line: “Wow, treasure comes out of those clubs!”

ko.title: 딱! 개암 깨무는 소리
ko.body: 숨어 있던 나무꾼이 그만 개암을 딱 깨물었어요. 큰 소리에 도깨비들이 집이 무너지는 줄 알고 놀랐지요.

en.title: Crack! A Hazelnut
en.body: Hiding in the corner, the woodcutter bit down on a hazelnut by accident. The loud crack made the goblins think the house was falling down.

ko.title: 두고 간 방망이
ko.body: 도깨비들은 방망이를 두고 허둥지둥 달아났어요. 빈집에는 도깨비 방망이만 덩그러니 남았지요.

en.title: The Club Left Behind
en.body: The goblins dropped their club and scrambled away in a panic. All alone in the empty house sat one magic club.

ko.title: 집으로 돌아와
ko.body: 나무꾼은 방망이를 들고 조심조심 집으로 돌아왔어요. 하지만 욕심내지 않고 꼭 필요한 만큼만 쓰기로 했지요.

en.title: Back Home Again
en.body: The woodcutter carried the club home, careful every step. But he wasn't greedy, so he used only what he truly needed.
en.line: “I'll borrow just as much as I need.”

ko.title: 이웃과 나누기
ko.body: 나무꾼은 방망이로 쌀과 이불을 만들어 가난한 이웃과 나눴어요. 마을에 따뜻한 웃음이 번졌지요.

en.title: Sharing with Neighbors
en.body: With the club he made rice and warm blankets for his poor neighbors. Warm laughter spread all through the village.

ko.title: 욕심부린 이웃
ko.body: 이를 본 욕심 많은 이웃이 일부러 빈집을 찾아갔어요. 방망이를 통째로 가지려는 마음뿐이었지요.

en.title: A Greedy Neighbor
en.body: A greedy neighbor saw this and went to the empty house on purpose. All he wanted was to grab the magic club for himself.
en.line: “I'll take a whole pile of treasure too!”

ko.title: 들통난 거짓
ko.body: 이번엔 도깨비들이 속지 않고 거짓을 알아챘어요. 욕심부린 이웃은 보물 대신 빈손으로 돌아갔지요.

en.title: The Lie Is Found Out
en.body: This time the goblins weren't fooled and saw through the lie. The greedy neighbor went home empty-handed, with no treasure at all.

ko.title: 정직한 마음이 보물
ko.body: 착한 나무꾼은 정직하고 나누는 마음 덕분에 복을 받았어요. 진짜 보물은 욕심이 아니라 따뜻한 마음이랍니다.

en.title: An Honest Heart Is the Treasure
en.body: The kind woodcutter was blessed for his honest, sharing heart. The real treasure isn't greed, but a warm and giving heart.
en.line: “When you're honest, good fortune finds you!”
